_doc: Style frames of «Как работает Claude» measured by scripts/still-check.mjs before the quality gate, one spec per composition (desk + phone: scenes 1/9; token board: scenes 2–4; scheme stand: scenes 5–8 and the inset of scene 9). Coral = the piece that ends the output (a chip on the phone, a tile on the board and on the stand): one small part by nature (parts-plan.md §0 p. 5, §5), so the specs set coralMin with a note instead of switching coral off.

specs.coralNote: frame 0 is the wide shot of the desk: the coral is the last typed chip on the phone screen, ≈ 0.2 % of the band by nature; frame 1 (close-up on the screen) passes the default share

frame 0 = scene 2: the coral is the last tile of row 2 (one word tile). Frame 1 = scene 3 framed on the candidate column (the coral tile is left of the frame); frame 2 = scene 4 with a candidate in flight: the coral stays on the old last tile until the new one lands (parts-plan §4), at the frame's left edge

the coral is the last written tile of line 2 (one word tile, ≈ 100 × 34 px). Frames 0 (scene 5, nothing written yet), 2 (scene 7 mid: the clamp on its way, line 2 of panel 2 not written) and 5 (the inset of scene 9) carry no coral by design
